# Lifafa

**This is the fork behind Lifafa** (`org.tunaos.lifafa`), the TunaOS office
suite's email client: [Hylki](https://github.com/hyprlab/hylki) with native
Tuta and Proton Mail accounts. It follows upstream daily, and everything but
those two kinds of account is upstream's app.

GitHub shows this page in place of the repository's `README.md`, which stays
upstream's own so the daily merge never conflicts on it.

- [Hylki's README](../README.md): the app, its features and documentation.
- [Tuta and Proton Mail accounts](../fork/ACCOUNTS.md): what the fork adds,
  and how to use it.
- [The fork](../fork/README.md): the rebrand, how upstream is followed,
  building and releases.
- [The helpers](../fork/HELPERS.md): building, packaging and licences of
  `hylki-tuta` and `hylki-proton`.
- [Changelog](../fork/CHANGELOG.md): the fork's own changes.
- [Maintaining](../fork/MAINTAINING.md): what goes upstream and what stays
  here.

Neither Tuta nor Proton endorses third-party clients built this way; that is
why upstream declined them ([#584](https://github.com/hyprlab/hylki/pull/584),
[#586](https://github.com/hyprlab/hylki/pull/586)).
